verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch is an API development and testing client, not an API gateway, so enforcing authentication on upstream APIs through gateway plugins or policies is outside its product category. Its documented OAuth 2.0 grant types, collection-level auth and PEM/PFX client certificates are client-side ways to send credentials. They do not enforce authentication on traffic.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce authentication (API keys, OAuth2, JWT, mTLS) on upstream APIs via gateway plugins or policies
